matches.rationale: The candidate owned release governance for an engineering organization, improved engineering delivery metrics, and ran portfolio planning and reporting, though no budget specific to engineering is stated.
The candidate has led organizations of up to 320 people as a manager of managers, which exceeds a 35-person team led through four managers.
The candidate has executive exposure to the CTO, though their prior reporting line is not stated.
The candidate owned technology operations for a 320-person engineering organization and ran engineering platform and transformation work at enterprise scale.
The candidate is explicitly a manager of managers with 18 years in leadership.
The candidate reported quarterly to the executive team and has worked with the CIO, CTO, COO and the board audit committee.
